snippet.title: Every Moment is Infinite | Halo Infinite Multiplayer Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience Halo’s celebrated multiplayer reimagined and free-to-play! With devastating new weapons, tons of maps and modes in matchmaking, incredible customization options, and countless community Forge creations to experience, Halo Infinite is the franchise’s most expansive multiplayer offering to date.
